## Who we are

[AB//LABS](https://ab-labs.io) provides intelligence and support across maritime, defence and logistics: vessel tracking and port assessments, operational intelligence before and during deployments, threat and risk analysis, and advisory work on building analytical capability. The tools and lists on this page come out of that work.

AB//LABS began as Atlas|Bear Labs, the technical side of [Atlas|Bear](https://atlasbear.co), and is now a company of its own. The two still work together, and our repositories keep the `atlas-bear` name on GitHub for now. Atlas|Bear's [Academy](https://www.atlasbear.academy) runs the professional development programmes our people teach on, and much of what is on this page is used each year at the [Summer School on Illicit Trade](https://www.rug.nl/education/summer-winter-schools/illicit-trade).

[Atlas|Bear](https://atlasbear.co) provides intelligence advisory and operational support to organisations deploying people, technology and capital in difficult markets, with the fieldwork, logistics and professional services that need specialist knowledge. Every Atlas|Bear engagement supports independent fieldwork, impact investment and critical projects in vulnerable communities worldwide, simply by operating within its network.

The [Atlas|Bear Academy](https://www.atlasbear.academy) runs training and professional development for people who want to do this work well, online and in person; our people teach on it. [The Mombasa Method](https://www.atlasbear.academy/course/the-mombasa-method) is its flagship on-demand programme. For custom training, write to [courier@atlasbear.co](mailto:courier@atlasbear.co).

## Contributing

Every resource has an issue form for proposals and corrections, written criteria for what goes in, and a changelog. We sweep the guide and the lists twice a year, in spring and autumn, and release each sweep. Pull requests are welcome; the repositories explain the format. Please keep to our [community guidelines](https://github.com/atlas-bear/.github/blob/main/profile/COMMUNITY_GUIDELINES.md).

## Contact

[support@ab-labs.io](mailto:support@ab-labs.io) for anything about these resources. [Waterline](https://maraiq.substack.com/) is our newsletter.
